title: Concept: Variable format string (cpp) — review required
description: In cpp, syslogs*([^,]+,s*[A-Za-z_]w*s*) interprets a variable as format text. Specifiers like %x and %n turn output routines into memory disclosure and write primitives. The remedy is fixed formats (a fixed "%s" format).
applicability: cpp formatting calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Memory disclosure and write; HIGH severity where the value is remotely influenced.
